title: Titanium Equal Tee (ASME B16.9)
system: Chemical Pipe Fittings & Flow Control Components
function: Seamless equal tee for pipe branching
alloyReason: Grade 2 CP-Ti (UNS R50400) is selected for Titanium Equal Tee (ASME B16.9) where formability and corrosion resistance are prioritized over absolute strength. With 40% elongation and excellent weldability, Grade 2 CP-Ti forms a stable TiO₂ passive film that provides immunity to pitting in chloride environments up to 260°C. Its 345 MPa yield strength with 30% elongation makes it ideal for Seamless equal tee for pipe branching requiring cold forming or bending without cracking. This rationale is driven by seamless equal tee for pipe branching and service environment demands.
process: Hot forming plate rolling for pipe fitting geometry
CNC corrosion allowance with Class 6g gauge
TIG welding Grade 2 with Class 6g gauge
Hydrostatic shell test with Class 6g gauge
surfaceTreatment: Pickling + passivation per ASTM B600 to restore TiO2 passive layer integrity after welding or hot forming — tailored for seamless equal tee application
commonFailures: Galvanic acceleration at Ti-steel weld joint - controlled by PTFE insulating gasket + CP adjustment — critical for seamless equal tee performance

faq.q: What inspection and testing is available for Titanium Equal Tee (ASME B16.9) pressure-containing components?
faq.a: Titanium Equal Tee (ASME B16.9) can be supplied with hydrostatic pressure testing at 1.3× design pressure per ASME B31.3, PMI (positive material identification) via OES analyzer on 100% of production, ultrasonic wall thickness scanning, and helium leak testing to 1×10⁻⁹ mbar·L/s. For seamless equal tee, 100% PMI + hydrostatic testing is the standard specification.

faq.q: What is the typical lead time for Titanium Equal Tee (ASME B16.9) orders?
faq.a: Standard lead time for Titanium Equal Tee (ASME B16.9) is 15-25 business days depending on quantity and complexity. Rush orders (3-5 working days) are available for prototype evaluation. Sample evaluation (1-5 units) can be expedited to 5-7 business days. Volume pricing is available for production quantities above 100 units.

faq.q: What material certifications are provided with Titanium Equal Tee (ASME B16.9)?
faq.a: Each Titanium Equal Tee (ASME B16.9) shipment includes EN 10204 Type 3.1 mill test certificate with chemical analysis, mechanical properties, and heat identification. Dimensional inspection reports and Certificate of Conformance (CoC) are standard. First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR) per AS9102 are available on request for seamless equal tee.
